So it can no longer hand you a confident sentence and hope the confidence does the heavy lifting.

That may help. Or it may produce longer, more decorative bad advice. Have you run it?

Fair. But if it tells us where the leap happens, at least we can catch it before we build three days of nonsense around it.
That is a better outcome than discovering the leap after the printer has already made evidence.
All right. Same question, different versions, and we compare the suggestions. If the new prompt makes the agent more useful, great. If not, I have taught it to write footnotes.
A modest improvement. Previously, it could be wrong with no paperwork.

synthesized_brief_joined:
Patch: I changed one little thing in the workshop agent’s suggestion prompt. Before it gives me a recommendation, it has to say what it’s basing that recommendation on.

Rivet: So it can no longer hand you a confident sentence and hope the confidence does the heavy lifting.

Patch: Exactly. It can still suggest something weird. Weird is welcome. But now it has to separate “I noticed this” from “therefore you should do that.”

Rivet: That may help. Or it may produce longer, more decorative bad advice. Have you run it?

Patch: Once. I asked how to improve a prototype, and it gave the suggestion, then listed the observation behind it, then admitted the rest was an assumption.

Rivet: Once.

Patch: I knew you were going to say that.

Rivet: You changed the words it receives. We do not yet know whether it will behave differently next time, or merely explain itself more elegantly while being wrong.

Patch: Fair. But if it tells us where the leap happens, at least we can catch it before we build three days of nonsense around it.

Rivet: That is a better outcome than discovering the leap after the printer has already made evidence.

Patch: All right. Same question, different versions, and we compare the suggestions. If the new prompt makes the agent more useful, great. If not, I have taught it to write footnotes.

Rivet: A modest improvement. Previously, it could be wrong with no paperwork.
